title: Jesus... My Dream Stopped Feeling Like A Promise. 📖
topic: his dream went quiet so long ago that he now tells it like an old story instead of expecting it

bible.text: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my dream stopped feeling like a promise. 📖

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It's a story I tell so it doesn't hurt.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Bethlehem was promised centuries before it arrived. Promises outlive the quiet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So the silence doesn't mean You forgot?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: My word outlasts every quiet year. Stay awake in the meantime.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your dream isn't a story. It's still moving.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone whose dream went quiet. 🕯️
